page: Microsoft Azure EC64eds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the ECEDV6 server family. Powered by an Intel processor with x86_64 architecture, this instance features 64 dedicated vCPUs and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It is designed for memory-intensive workloads, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per core, which totals 512.0 GB of system memory.

For storage-heavy operations, the server includes 3780 GB of local storage and is premium storage capable. This local disk capacity, combined with the large memory footprint, makes the instance suitable for large-scale databases, in-memory caching, and data analytics. The hardware profile offers high resource density, balancing substantial memory capacity with dedicated compute resources to deliver qualitative cost efficiency for enterprise-scale database and analytical workloads.
description: Microsoft Azure EC64eds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine from the ECEDV6 family, featuring 64 dedicated vCPUs on an Intel x86_64 architecture. Operating under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this instance delivers 512.0 GB of RAM, establishing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It is equipped with 3780 GB of local storage and supports premium storage configurations. Lacking integrated GPUs, the server is engineered specifically for memory-intensive and storage-heavy workloads. The combination of high-capacity local disk space and a massive memory footprint makes this instance highly suitable for large-scale databases, in-memory data processing, and enterprise analytics.
